get-task-dispatch.description: Read the task dispatch settings: each board's mode (manual or pull) and the switches that stop dispatch (pause, quiet hours, a board stopped after 3 failures in a row, a usage limit).

params.name: session
params.description: Session name. Omit from a pane for the pane's own session, and from outside every pane for the most recently active one.

params.name: project
params.description: The project board, by origin URL. Omit for the session's own cards.

returns.name: paused
returns.description: True while dispatch is paused.

returns.name: paused_by
returns.description: Who paused it.

returns.name: stopped
returns.description: Why all dispatch stopped on its own, such as usage limit. Empty when it did not.

returns.name: quiet
returns.description: The quiet hours, local time, such as 22:00-07:00.

returns.name: quiet_now
returns.description: True inside the quiet hours.

returns.name: boards
returns.description: The boards with a mode or a stop: board, project or session, mode, failures (dispatched cards in a row that did not finish), stopped, verify and verify_timeout.

returns.name: cap
returns.description: Auto's agents at once, in total.

returns.name: machine_cap
returns.description: Auto's agents at once on one machine.

returns.name: running
returns.description: Auto's agents now.

returns.name: board
returns.description: The board the call named, also when it is manual. An auto board adds preset, running, waiting and note.

set-task-dispatch.description: Change task dispatch. mode sets a board to manual, pull or auto: in pull, an agent that finishes its card is given the board's next open card, as mail from tuios; in auto, the daemon starts the board's preset agent for each open card, in a new worktree, and mails it the card. preset sets that agent; auto needs one. cap bounds the agents at once. verify sets the command run in a card's worktree when its agent is done: a pass moves the card to review, a fail to todo. pause stops all dispatch at once, and any pane may pause. resume lifts the pause and every stop. quiet sets the hours when dispatch gives no card. A pane needs admin for every action but pause, and verify is refused from every pane. Refused over a link.

params.name: session
params.description: Session name. Omit from a pane for the pane's own session, and from outside every pane for the most recently active one.

params.name: project
params.description: The project board, by origin URL. Omit for the session's own cards.

params.name: mode
params.description: With mode: the board's new mode.

params.name: quiet
params.description: With quiet: a span of local time such as 22:00-07:00, or off.

params.name: agent
params.description: With preset or mode auto: the agent auto starts. A card's own agent comes first.

params.name: model
params.description: With preset: as start-agent takes it.

params.name: effort
params.description: With preset: as start-agent takes it.

params.name: permission_mode
params.description: With preset: as start-agent takes it. Omit for the agent's own default.

params.name: machine
params.description: With preset: here (the default), any, or a linked machine.

params.name: cap
params.description: With cap: agents at once in total, 0 for 3.

params.name: machine_cap
params.description: With cap: on one machine, 0 for 2.

params.name: verify
params.description: With verify: a shell line, or off.

params.name: human_nonce
params.description: The attached client's nonce, to act as the person (by human). One that does not verify is refused with not_human.

returns.name: paused
returns.description: True while dispatch is paused.

returns.name: paused_by
returns.description: Who paused it.

returns.name: stopped
returns.description: Why all dispatch stopped on its own, such as usage limit. Empty when it did not.

returns.name: quiet
returns.description: The quiet hours, local time, such as 22:00-07:00.

returns.name: quiet_now
returns.description: True inside the quiet hours.

returns.name: boards
returns.description: The boards with a mode or a stop: board, project or session, mode, failures (dispatched cards in a row that did not finish), stopped, verify and verify_timeout.

returns.name: cap
returns.description: Auto's agents at once, in total.

returns.name: machine_cap
returns.description: Auto's agents at once on one machine.

returns.name: running
returns.description: Auto's agents now.

returns.name: board
returns.description: The board the call named, also when it is manual. An auto board adds preset, running, waiting and note.
